nodes.name: Claim Due Schedules
nodes.notes: SETUP REQUIRED: replace YOUR_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF and select an n8n Custom Auth credential containing both apikey and Authorization: Bearer headers for the Supabase service role. Never use this credential in the browser.

nodes.name: Calculate Monthly Occurrence
nodes.notes: Day 29–31 falls back to the month's final day. A null next_run_at is initialized for a future occurrence and does not create a job immediately.

nodes.name: Initialize Next Run
nodes.notes: SETUP REQUIRED: use the same Supabase Custom Auth credential as the claim node. This only initializes a future run; it does not send or queue anything.

nodes.name: Enqueue Idempotent Job
nodes.notes: SETUP REQUIRED: use the same Supabase Custom Auth credential. This RPC atomically creates the queued job and advances the schedule. It does not deliver messages.
